variables.name: LakehouseName
variables.note: Display name of the lakehouse. Notebooks resolve it at runtime, so no default-lakehouse binding is needed.

variables.name: DefaultDomain
variables.note: Primary mail domain. Identity fallback: localpart@DefaultDomain.

variables.name: AssignedHoursPerMonth
variables.note: Hours one full-time month of a CRM assignment represents (sold vs utilized).

variables.name: NonLoggerWindowDays
variables.note: Expected users with no worklog in this many trailing days appear in gold_mart_nonloggers.

variables.name: FullWindowMonths
variables.note: Full mode re-extracts from the first day of the month this many months back.

variables.name: MaxUnmatchedHoursShare
variables.note: Quality warning when more than this share of hours cannot be attributed to a user.

variables.name: SyntheticSeed
variables.note: Seed for nb_land_synthetic. Same seed, same synthetic world.

variables.name: KeyVaultUri
variables.note: https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/ - source-system credentials are read from here with notebookutils.credentials.getSecret. Never put a secret in this library.
